name: code_grep
title: Search code and text files
description: Use instead of `rg`/`grep` for exact text (a string, identifier or comment) in indexed code and text files (markdown, config, data; not PDFs). Rows `<line>: <text>` (`<line>-`: context) sit under `# <file>` and `## <symbol>` headers, after `stale` (edited since indexing), `skipped_files` (unsearchable) and `total` (with `next_cursor`: hits from `cursor` on). A `path` or `language` matching no indexed file is an error. Example: {"pattern":"cache_root(","path":"src/"}

pattern.description: Text to find, not empty; a literal unless `regex` is true.

regex.description: Treat `pattern` as a Rust regex; `^` and `$` match at every line.

path.description: Prefix, or a glob when it has `*`, e.g. `src/`.

context.description: Lines before and after each hit, 0-10.

changed.description: Files changed since rev's merge base (empty: HEAD), A..B or A...B; main...HEAD+importers adds importers.

name: code_outline
title: Outline a file
description: Use to see what a file contains before, or instead of, reading it: each symbol's kind, signature and 1-based `line`/`end_line`, plus its imports. Feed a span to `code_read`. Code files only. `stale`: edited since indexing; outlined as it is now. Example: {"path":"src/store.rs"}

name: code_read
title: Read a symbol or line span
description: Use to read one function or type, or an exact line span, instead of the whole file. A body over 128 KiB is cut (at a line end if it can) and flagged `truncated`: read on from `end_line` + 1. `stale`: edited since indexing; parsed as it is now. Example: {"path":"src/store.rs","symbol":"open"}

symbol.description: Symbol whose body to return (exact name).

kind.description: With `symbol`: its kind, when several share the name.

line.description: First line of a span, 1-based. With `symbol`: a line inside the definition meant.

end_line.description: Last line of a span, inclusive (default: `line`). Not with `symbol`.

name: code_refs
title: Find call sites, implementations and importers
description: Use for what calls, implements or imports X, or which definition a use binds to (`relation`). Callers are call sites, not type uses or `use` lines. `hits` maps files to rows: `line`, `callee` if not `name`, `stale` if edited since. A row without `resolution` has the page's `resolution_default` (none: name_only). Resolutions: same_file, imported, scope_resolved (a local binding), elsewhere (not the pinned definition), name_only (unchecked; see `resolution_note`), external (not indexed), path_match (HTTP call by literal URL to route `name`, e.g. `GET /a/{id}`, or a pinned handler; `ambiguous`: routes tie). Example: {"name":"open_store","path":"src/store.rs"}

name.description: Name called, implemented or defined; for `importers`, whole segments of the import path.

relation.description: What to list (default `callers`). `definition` takes no `limit`, `cursor` or `max_tokens`.

path.description:
`callers`: the file defining `name`, to pin it. `definition`: the reference's file (required).
`importers`/`cycles`: that file (no `name`).

line.description:
Needs `path`. `callers`: a 1-based line inside the definition meant. `definition`: the
reference's line (required).

column.description: `definition` only: 1-based column (default: where `name` is on the line).

match.description:
`exact` (default): the name or a path ending in it; `substring`: names holding it. Not with
`importers`/`definition`.

resolution.description: `callers` only: keep rows of these resolutions, comma-separated.

changed.description: `callers` only: files changed since rev's merge base (empty: HEAD), A..B or A...B; main...HEAD+importers adds importers.

name: code_search
title: Search code by meaning
description: Use when you know what the code does but not a name or string in it: searches code by meaning and returns pointers (path, `line`/`end_line`, symbol), not bodies; copies of a file share a hit (`also_at`). `lanes_unavailable`: lanes that did not run. Read a hit with `code_read`. Example: {"query":"retry a failed upload with backoff"}

query.description: What the code does, in plain words.

path.description: Prefix, or a glob when it has `*`, e.g. `src/`.

changed.description: Files changed since rev's merge base (empty: HEAD), A..B or A...B; main...HEAD+importers adds importers.

name: code_symbols
title: Find a definition
description: Use for "where is X defined" when you know (part of) the name: finds functions, types, constants and other symbols; a row is `"<path>:<line>: <signature>"`. Ranked exact, prefix, substring, then `fuzzy`; `stale`: files edited since indexing (lines current). Definitions only; for other text, `code_grep`. Example: {"name":"parse_config","kind":"function"}

kind.description: function, method, struct, enum, class, interface, trait, type, const, module, macro, route.

path.description: Prefix, or a glob when it has `*`, e.g. `src/`.

fuzzy.description: Also match the name as a fuzzy subsequence, ranked last.

changed.description: Files changed since rev's merge base (empty: HEAD), A..B or A...B; main...HEAD+importers adds importers.

name: docs_search
title: Search documents
description: Use to find where a topic is discussed in the repository's documents (markdown, PDFs, Office, HTML, email, notebooks) instead of opening them. Ranks passages by meaning and words after the filters, citing path, pages, section and lines. Code: `code_grep`/`code_search`. Example: {"query":"how releases are versioned"}

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

format.description: pdf, office, html, markdown, email, notebook, text or other.

path.description: Prefix, or a glob when it has `*`, e.g. `src/`.

keywords.description: Whole keywords, comma-separated; any one matches.

entity.description: Keep chunks naming an entity of this category, e.g. `PERSON`.

name: find_files
title: Find files
description: Use instead of `find`/`fd`/`ls -R` to locate a file by a fuzzy fragment of its name or path (one typo allowed), or to list files without `query`. Covers every file git tracks. A `path` or `language` no listed file has is an error. Example: {"query":"readme"}

query.description: Fuzzy fragment of a file name or path; omit to list.

path.description: Prefix, or a glob when it has `*`, e.g. `src/`.

min_lines.description: Only code files of at least this many lines, largest first; `files` maps path to lines.

changed.description: Files changed since rev's merge base (empty: HEAD), A..B or A...B; main...HEAD+importers adds importers.

name: git_blame
title: Blame
description: Use instead of `git blame` for "who last changed this": per-line authorship of a file, a 1-based `line`..`end_line` span or one `symbol`, at `rev`. `hunks`: `"<line>[-<end>] <sha>[ <old path>]"` (old path when moved); `commits`: each sha's author, time and summary. Example: {"path":"src/store.rs","symbol":"open"}

line.description:
First line of a span, 1-based, as numbered at `rev`. With `symbol`: a line inside the
definition meant.

end_line.description: Last line of a span, inclusive (default: `line`). Needs `line`; not with `symbol`.

symbol.description: Blame this symbol's lines, as they are at `rev`, instead of a span.

name: git_diff
title: Diff and status
description: Use instead of `git status`/`git diff`. No arguments: the working-tree status (staged, modified, untracked; 200 paths a list). A file `path` diffs its working tree against HEAD, or `from`/`to`; `structural`: symbols added and removed and a `common` count. A diff over 200 hunks or 128 KiB is cut (`truncated`). Example: {"path":"src/store.rs","from":"HEAD~1","to":"HEAD"}

path.description:
File to diff, or a directory ending in `/` to narrow the status; omit every argument for
the whole working-tree status.

to.description: New revision (default: the working tree). Needs `path`; not with `structural`.

structural.description: Symbol-level diff of `from` against the indexed working tree, not text hunks.

name: git_log
title: Commit history
description: Use instead of `git log`/`git show` for "what changed recently", "what touched this file or function" or "which commit mentions X". `{}` lists recent commits; `path`, `query`/`author`, `path`+`symbol` or `rev` narrow it. Rows: `"<sha> <summary>"`, `[introduced]`/`[removed]` for a symbol; recent and directory lists add `files` (sha to path to change). `rev`: one commit whole. Symbol and directory history is read in commit batches: an empty page with `next_cursor` is not the end. Example: {"path":"src/store.rs","limit":5}

path.description:
Only commits touching this file, or a directory (trailing `/`; 200 commits a page). Not with
`query` or `author`.

query.description: Words the commit message must all contain. Combines with `author` only.

author.description:
Words the author name or email must all contain; rows then name the author. Combines with
`query` only.

symbol.description: Commits that changed this symbol's body; needs `path`, combines only with `line`.

line.description: With `symbol`: a 1-based line inside the definition meant.

rev.description: Show this one commit in full; `max_tokens` bounds its file list. Combines with nothing.

name: index_rescan
title: Re-index
description: Use when a result says stale or a new file is missing (the index follows edits): re-indexes `paths`; with none, the whole workspace (an empty, degraded or rescan_needed index, or changed `scan.extra_roots` files, which `paths` skips). Writes only the cache. Example: {"paths":["src/store.rs"]}

paths.description: Repo-relative files or directories to re-index (default: the whole workspace).

name: index_status
title: Index status
description: Use when a result is unexpectedly empty or says "not indexed": reports files indexed per language, whether a scan is running or the index is degraded, the cache directory, and the branch and HEAD. Example: {}

name: memory_save
title: Save a note
description: Use to remember a decision, convention or finding for later sessions and other agents in this repository. Saving an existing `key` replaces it. Notes are plain text on local disk: never save secrets. Example: {"key":"decision/auth-tokens","value":"Tokens rotate every 24h.","tags":["auth"]}

name: memory_search
title: Recall notes
description: Use to recall notes saved with `memory_save`: `query` searches by meaning (by words when no model loads), `key` reads one, `prefix` lists by key prefix, no arguments lists all. Lists show 200 characters of a value; `key` reads it whole. Example: {"query":"token rotation"}

query.description: Search by meaning. At most one of `query`, `key`, `prefix`; none lists every note.

key.description: Read one note by exact key.

prefix.description: List notes whose key starts with this.

tags.description: Notes carrying any of these. Not with `key`.

limit.description: Max notes (default 10 for `query`, 100 for a listing). Not with `key`.

cursor.description: A prior listing's `next_cursor`. Not with `query` or `key`.
